notes:
Overview: Garrison Search Labs is an Army-affiliated R&D unit building a classified enterprise search/RAG capability. Primary focus: embeddings-based retrieval with cross-encoder reranking for high-precision evidence retrieval. Index scale: current corpus 30-75M documents (scans + OCR + email archives). Expected growth 10-20% qtr. 

Key requirements (short):
- Fully air-gapped on-prem deployment or VPC-private deployment with no egress allowed.
- Strong provenance and audit logging + KMS integration for key management.
- NIST 800-53 controls required; FedRAMP equivalency desired.
- Background-checked engineers for on-site install windows.
- Contracting: GSA-like procurement, CAGE code, long lead times (3-6 months).

Performance targets:
- Query latency (tail, P95): <=150ms for simple retrieval + reranker in their staging environment; <=250ms acceptable under heavy load for deep reranking.
- Throughput: 150-300 QPS baseline (batched retrieval), with bursts to 1k qps for incident response.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost-per-query < $0.03 (embeddings + rerank amortized).
- Indexing window: nightly incremental ingest; near-real-time add for high-priority docs (~<5 min target).

Technical constraints & preferences:
- Prefer local embedding models (quantized) with ability to fallback to curated open variants.
- Reranking: cross-encoder on GPU preferred; must support fallback to cheaper bi-encoder score if capacity constrained.
- Need deterministic rollout and pinning of model versions; audit trail for any model change.
- Prefers integrated batching + KV-cache capabilities to reduce costs for repeated prefix queries.

Procurement notes & stakeholders:
- Primary sponsor: Lt. Col. Rajesh Patel (Program Lead) — cares most about reliability & security.
- Technical lead: Dr. Emily Hart (Chief Scientist) — focuses on reranker F1 and QA harness.
- Procurement lead: Marcus Allen (Contracting Officer) — needs SOW and compliance attachments.
- Quote: "We cannot risk cloud egress; install must be completed during a 2-week window with cleared staff."

Current POC plan:
- 2-week air-gapped POC in customer data center: install private control plane, local embedding service, and reranker on a 4-GPU rack.
- Evaluation metrics: recall@10, MRR, reranker latency P95, operational runbook completion.
- Deliverables: security attestation, runbook, SOC-like audit log export format.

- Background checks for on-site Redwood engineers (HR forms pending).
- Finalizing PO/contract terms: indemnity and data-residency clauses under review.
- Customer requests sample pricing tied to indexing band (0-25M/25-50M/50-100M) + SLA for on-prem support.
